 the State with Asi Ps:

 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Saurabh Banerjee
 Order

The present application has been filed the applicant under Section 438 Cr.P.C. seeking anticipatory bail in FIR No.0004/2023 dated 13.02.2023 under Sections 498A/406/34 Indian Penal Code, 1860 [IPC] at PS: Crime (Women ) Cell, Nanakpura, Delhi.
2. Learned APP for the State, upon the instructions from the IO, submits that the charge-sheet has been filed on 23.08.2023.

She further submits that in view thereof, the custodial interrogation of the applicant is no more required.
3.
In view of the aforesaid, the present bail application for grant of anticipatory bail is disposed of as infructuous.
SAURABH BANERJEE, J OCTOBER 17, 2023/So This is a digitally signed order.
